instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a fine strainer. Put it in a pot with 1 3/4 cups water and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover with the lid slightly open and simmer 12 to 13 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and spread it on a plate to cool.

While the quinoa cooks, pull the kale leaves off the stems, wash and dry them well, and slice them into thin strips. Toss in a large bowl with 1 tbsp of the oil and a pinch of salt and rub the leaves between your fingers 2 to 3 minutes, until they darken and soften.
Whisk the juice of both lemons with the last 1/4 cup oil, the vinegar, the minced garlic, 1/2 tsp salt and the pepper.
Chop 1 cup of broccoli florets finely. Dice the red pepper, chop 1/3 cup of the red onion, and drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Add the quinoa, chickpeas, broccoli, pepper, onion and pumpkin seeds to the kale. Pour the dressing over and toss well. Serve right away, or chill it first.
For packed lunches, divide it into containers. It keeps in the fridge up to 4 days.
method_notes: About 35 minutes, and it keeps for days, so it suits making ahead. Peas and Crayons (4.99 from 93) is the lead: quinoa, massaged kale, chickpeas, broccoli, red pepper and onion in a light lemon dressing. The lead has only 2 cups of kale and almonds with optional feta; this uses a whole bunch of kale so it reads as a kale salad, pumpkin seeds instead of almonds, and no feta. Ambitious Kitchen (5.0 from 23) massages the kale with half its dressing, and Foolproof Living adds avocado and pomegranate; neither is used here.
